warnings: op1 direct read (house 11). LAST STRUCTURAL SHEET (S-15, 15/15) — STRUCTURAL DISCIPLINE (S) COMPLETE for this house.

ZONE 3 IS GENUINELY HEAVIER, NOT JUST TIGHTER TIES: column rebar upgrades from 4-Ø12mm (zone 1&2, S-14) to 4-Ø16mm here, column size grows 0.20x0.20 -> 0.25x0.25, AND beam sections B1/B5/B6/B6X must be ENLARGED to 0.15x0.40m (note 2) — a genuinely different structural design, not just closer stirrup spacing. This confirms the BOQ's zone-3 blocks will have real quantity differences vs zone-1&2, not just relabeled identical content.

Zone 3 = the 11 northern/western provinces bordering fault lines (เชียงราย, เชียงใหม่, แม่ฮ่องสอน, etc.) — the highest seismic risk tier per กฎกระทรวง 2564, consistent with getting the heaviest reinforcement of the three BOQ tiers (general < zone 1&2 < zone 3).
